desc:
Welcome to Night City's forgotten grid. Pick a faction, install cyberware, run the rooftops and ride your Voltrunner through a neon city full of bosses, raids and rival runners.

CODES:
TY20KMEMBERS - 1 of every token + $1,000 + 20 Chips
UPDATE1.5 - 25 Origin Spins + $500 + 20 Chips
NEWCYBERWARES - 15 Origin Spins + $750 + 30 Chips
SORRY4DELAY - 3 Legendary Chests

PC CONTROLS:
WASD — Move | Space — Jump | Shift — Sprint
V — Crouch/Slide | Q — Dash | Alt — Shiftlock
Click — Attack | Right Click — Aim | F — Block
R — Heavy/Reload | B — Execute | G — Carry
E — Interact | Z/X/C — Cyberware | H — Bike
Ctrl + 1/2/3 — Inhalers | Tab — Scanner
P — Phone | I — Inventory | N — Emotes | M — Menu

CONSOLE CONTROLS (Xbox / PlayStation):
A/Cross — Jump | B/Circle — Dash
L3 — Sprint | R3 — Crouch/Slide
RT/R2 — Attack | LT/L2 — Heavy/Aim
LB/L1 — Block | X/Square — Interact/Reload
Y/Triangle — Switch
